room_description: An Egyptian tomb-themed room with walls covered in hieroglyphics, two golden Sphinx statues guarding the exit door, and various stone pedestals and artifacts scattered around.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the Egyptian tomb room.
Finding a feather duster/brush behind a tilted stone block.
Collecting a chisel from the shelf beneath a small wooden chest.
Using the brush to clean off a dusty, blank stone panel on a pedestal.
Retrieving a wooden mallet from the newly revealed compartment.
Using the mallet and chisel to break open the clay pot on the floor.
Unrolling the scroll found in the pot to reveal Arabic numerals (١٥٢٢).
Entering the corresponding symbols (1-5-2-2) into the slots on the wall panel.
Retrieving the key from the compartment that opens below the wall panel.
Unlocking the main door between the Sphinxes using the key.

solution_steps: Find the brush hidden behind a stone.
Use the brush on the blank, dusty square panel on the left pedestal.
Find the chisel on the shelf.
Combine the mallet and chisel to break the round clay pot on the floor.
Read the scroll to see the Arabic numerals '١٥٢٢' (1522).
Locate the wall panel with 4 vertical slots.
Change the slots to match the symbols for 1, 5, 2, and 2.

final_action: The player takes the key from the stone wall compartment and uses it to unlock the large door located in the center of the room.
